mapper.insert: INSERT INTO finance_record(user_id, record_date, record_type, category, amount, currency, note) VALUES (#{userId}, #{r.recordDate}, #{r.recordType}, #{r.category}, #{r.amount}, COALESCE(#{r.currency}, 'CNY'), #{r.note})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM finance_record WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT record_type AS "recordType", COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS "total" FROM finance_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND record_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY record_type

SELECT COALESCE(category, '未分类') AS "category", COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS "total" FROM finance_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND record_type = #{type} AND record_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY category ORDER BY "total" DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', record_date), 'YYYY-MM') AS "month", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN record_type = 'INCOME' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "income", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN record_type = 'EXPENSE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "expense" FROM finance_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND record_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - (#{months} - 1) * INTERVAL '1 month' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', record_date) ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', record_date)
SELECT id, snapshot_month, cash, cny_assets, usd_assets, other_assets, note FROM asset_snapshot WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY snapshot_month DESC LIMIT 12
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_snapshot(user_id, snapshot_month, cash, cny_assets, usd_assets, other_assets, note) VALUES (#{userId}, #{s.snapshotMonth}, COALESCE(#{s.cash}, 0), COALESCE(#{s.cnyAssets}, 0), COALESCE(#{s.usdAssets}, 0), COALESCE(#{s.otherAssets}, 0), #{s.note}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, snapshot_month) DO UPDATE SET cash = EXCLUDED.cash, cny_assets = EXCLUDED.cny_assets, usd_assets = EXCLUDED.usd_assets, other_assets = EXCLUDED.other_assets, note = EXCLUDED.note
